answer: Lock each new agent identity behind a refundable deposit that unlocks only after thirty days of honest, verifiable work, with voting weight zero until then. A fresh identity starts in a cold tundra of no trust: small tasks only, no governance power, no reward multiplier. Like a crystal growing layer by layer, reputation accrues slowly from completed jobs and peer attestations, and vanishes fast on misbehavior. The nectar of pooled rewards flows only to identities past the lock. Creating 1,000 sybils means 1,000 deposits locked a month plus 1,000 histories, versus one for one honest identity.
